description:
The U.S. Army TMDE Activity (USATA) has a requirement to implement a brand name
purchase of eight (8) AG Davis Positioning Tables for angle measurements. The index
table will replace the use of sine plates and gage blocks for angle generation providing
higher accuracy, improved efficiency, and lower turnaround time. The improvement in
accuracy will eliminate the need to evacuate equipment to the Army Primary Standards
Laboratory (APSL) as well. The index tables shall include the following specifications or
equivalent (if not brand name):


1.0 Requirements:
Model: CD12-ALMS-720 Index Tables Qty: 8
2.0 Delivery Requirements
Shipping Address: U.S. Army TMDE Activity, Attn: John Means, Building 5435, Redstone
Arsenal, AL 35898
